summary: Analyzes the security exposure that arises when CAPWAP splits the traditional access point into separate parts that may communicate across hostile network hops, focused on IEEE 802.11 deployments. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: If the boss computer and the wifi box talk over a road that bad guys can reach, they might listen in or lie. This memo lists what could go wrong.

questions: security of centralized wireless access point control
